## Solution

We compute the Lie bracket $[V_x, V_y]$ directly from the definition. For vector fields
$$A = a_\theta\,\partial_\theta + a_\phi\,\partial_\phi, \qquad B = b_\theta\,\partial_\theta + b_\phi\,\partial_\phi,$$
the Lie bracket is
$$[A,B] = \bigl(A(b_\theta) - B(a_\theta)\bigr)\,\partial_\theta + \bigl(A(b_\phi) - B(a_\phi)\bigr)\,\partial_\phi,$$
where $A(f) = a_\theta\,\partial_\theta f + a_\phi\,\partial_\phi f$.

### Identifying the components

For $V_x$: $\;a_\theta = -\sin\phi$, $\;a_\phi = -\cot\theta\cos\phi$.

For $V_y$: $\;b_\theta = \cos\phi$, $\;b_\phi = -\cot\theta\sin\phi$.

### $\partial_\theta$ component: $V_x(b_\theta) - V_y(a_\theta)$

$$V_x(\cos\phi) = (-\sin\phi)\underbrace{\partial_\theta(\cos\phi)}_{0} + (-\cot\theta\cos\phi)\underbrace{\partial_\phi(\cos\phi)}_{-\sin\phi} = \cot\theta\cos\phi\sin\phi.$$

$$V_y(-\sin\phi) = (\cos\phi)\underbrace{\partial_\theta(-\sin\phi)}_{0} + (-\cot\theta\sin\phi)\underbrace{\partial_\phi(-\sin\phi)}_{-\cos\phi} = \cot\theta\sin\phi\cos\phi.$$

Subtracting:
$$V_x(b_\theta) - V_y(a_\theta) = \cot\theta\cos\phi\sin\phi - \cot\theta\sin\phi\cos\phi = 0.$$

### $\partial_\phi$ component: $V_x(b_\phi) - V_y(a_\phi)$

First, $V_x(-\cot\theta\sin\phi)$. Using $\partial_\theta(-\cot\theta) = \csc^2\theta$ and $\partial_\phi(\sin\phi)=\cos\phi$:
$$\partial_\theta(-\cot\theta\sin\phi) = \csc^2\theta\sin\phi, \qquad \partial_\phi(-\cot\theta\sin\phi) = -\cot\theta\cos\phi.$$
$$V_x(-\cot\theta\sin\phi) = (-\sin\phi)(\csc^2\theta\sin\phi) + (-\cot\theta\cos\phi)(-\cot\theta\cos\phi) = -\sin^2\!\phi\,\csc^2\!\theta + \cot^2\!\theta\cos^2\!\phi.$$

Next, $V_y(-\cot\theta\cos\phi)$. Using $\partial_\phi(\cos\phi)=-\sin\phi$:
$$\partial_\theta(-\cot\theta\cos\phi) = \csc^2\theta\cos\phi, \qquad \partial_\phi(-\cot\theta\cos\phi) = \cot\theta\sin\phi.$$
$$V_y(-\cot\theta\cos\phi) = (\cos\phi)(\csc^2\theta\cos\phi) + (-\cot\theta\sin\phi)(\cot\theta\sin\phi) = \cos^2\!\phi\,\csc^2\!\theta - \cot^2\!\theta\sin^2\!\phi.$$

Subtracting:
$$V_x(b_\phi) - V_y(a_\phi) = \bigl(-\sin^2\!\phi\,\csc^2\!\theta + \cot^2\!\theta\cos^2\!\phi\bigr) - \bigl(\cos^2\!\phi\,\csc^2\!\theta - \cot^2\!\theta\sin^2\!\phi\bigr)$$
$$= -\csc^2\!\theta\,(\sin^2\!\phi+\cos^2\!\phi) + \cot^2\!\theta\,(\cos^2\!\phi+\sin^2\!\phi) = -\csc^2\!\theta + \cot^2\!\theta.$$

Using the identity $\csc^2\theta - \cot^2\theta = 1$:
$$V_x(b_\phi) - V_y(a_\phi) = -1.$$

### Result

Combining both components:

$$\boxed{[V_x, V_y] = -\,\partial_\phi.}$$

This is $-V_z$, where $V_z = \partial_\phi$ is the generator of rotations about the $z$-axis, consistent with the $\mathfrak{so}(3)$ commutation relation $[V_x, V_y] = -V_z$ (the sign reflecting the right-action convention for these vector fields on $S^2$).
